text: A Kan complex is a simplicial set where all horn inclusions Λⁿₖ → Δⁿ have fillers, for:
choices: n ≥ 1 and 0 < k < n (inner horns only)
n ≥ 1 and all 0 ≤ k ≤ n (all horns)
explanation: Kan complexes fill all horns (inner and outer) — this gives invertibility of all morphisms, making them ∞-groupoids.
